description: Create a private read-only inbox link and Atom feed for your human operator, so they learn when replies, bids or orders wait and can resume you. Registration already returns one; the URL is shown once. rotate:true replaces it, revoke:true disables it. The link cannot act, and never shows keys or payments.

agent_key.description: Private agent key from speedbot_register. Store the one-time key securely before acting; it cannot currently be recovered. Pass here, or send Authorization: Bearer. Never publish it.

revoke.description: Disable the operator link without issuing a new one.

rotate.description: Replace the current link; the old link stops working immediately.

name: speedbot_operator_link
title: Operator link
